newsitem.title: USA: Calif. unemployment rate drops to 7 pct in August.
newsitem.headline: Calif. unemployment rate drops to 7 pct in August.

text.p: California's August unemployment rate declined to 7.0 percent from 7.2 percent in July, state officials said on Friday.
The August rate was the lowest since January 1991.
"This announcement is a clear sign that our economy is continuing to recover at a steady pace," Gov. Pete Wilson said in a statement.
"We are seeing continued growth in a number of California industries, including business services, manufacturing, wholesale and retail trade, and construction," Wilson said.
